main_effect:
[When Digivolving] You may place 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card from your trash under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Then, up to 4 of your opponent's Digimon get -1000 DP for each of this Digimon's color until the end of your opponent's next turn.
[Your Turn] This Digimon is treated as also having the color of its digivolution cards. While this Digimon has 4 or more color, it gets +4000 DP.
